faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEHU Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Research Associate post at NEHU is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctoral Degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, or Life Sciences to be eligible for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process for the NEHU Research Associate recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it out, and send it to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the NEHU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate position at NEHU is contractual.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the NEHU located?
faq.answer: North Eastern Hill University (NEHU) is located in Shillong, Meghalaya, with the pincode 793022.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply online for this position?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NEHU?
faq.answer: The official website of North Eastern Hill University (NEHU) is not provided in the extracted data, but it is generally NEHU.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates with your application form.
